id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

formFieldValues.description:
A mapping of field name to value.

NOTE: the value of this field has to be a JSON object. JSON arrays may pass validation but should not be used.

dataRecord.description: The field which contains the data backing the form.

formType.description:
This enum field determines whether the form is a multi-step form, or a traditional, single-step form.
Possible values are 'single', 'multiStep'.
Defaults to 'single'.

formStatus.description: The status and state for form.

hideFooterButtons.description:
When true the cancel and submit buttons will be hidden.  Useful when the form is used for collecting data and then
the developer needs more control for what they want to do with that information.

primaryActionButtonLoading.description: Whether the primary action button is in the loading state.

secondaryActionButtonLoading.description: Whether the secondary action button is in the loading state.

primaryActionButtonDisabled.description: Whether the primary action button is disabled.

secondaryActionButtonDisabled.description: Whether the secondary action button is disabled.

fieldValidity.description:
A map of various fields and the associated validities. 'true' is considered valid, 'false' is considered invalid.
Additionally, if validity if null or undefined, it is indeterminate. This state is useful when you do not want to apply
any additional classes to the input and want to bring it to a state where it appears 'untouched'.

clearOnCancel.description:
Flag to determine if the form should be reset to the original data {@link UiSdlConnected#getInitialConfigFromState}
when the user clicks cancel.
If true clicking cancel will trigger {@link cancelFormAction} then {@link resetFormAction}.
If false clicking cancel will only trigger {@link cancelFormAction}.

currentStepIndex.description: Current step index for multi-step form.

customSubmit.description: Whether a custom submit action should be fired instead of the default submission actions.

debounceTime.description:
Debounce timer for all the input fields in milliseconds. Default is 300.
You can still use individual debounceTime for each input element.

multiStepProgressBarOrientation.description: The orientation of the progress bar for {@link UiSdlMultiStepFormFieldSet}.

multiStepAnyOrder.description:
Flag to determine whether or not a multistep form could be filled out of order.
Only set this value to true if the form is multistep and contains NO REQUIRED FIELDS.
If this value is set to true for forms with required fields, then it is possible the form could be submitted
without the required fields filled in.

width.description: Width of the form, int or double as percentage value or UiSdlFormWidth as value with its unit.

maxWidth.description:
Max width of the form, int or double as percentage value or UiSdlFormWidth as value with its unit.
By default it uses css token: `$sdl-form-max-width` which is 770px. With this option you override this value

submitDataSpec.description: The data spec for the default action to take when form is valid and `Submit` button is clicked.

submitRecord.description: A dummy field that is here to satisfy the requirement for `uiSdlDataSpec`.
